name: sharpdeps
description: Explore .NET project, namespace, and type dependencies with source evidence and cycle detection.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Viewing data is available; analysis, project evaluation, generators and runtime execution require workspace trust.

explorer/context.when: resourceExtname == .sln || resourceExtname == .slnx || resourceExtname == .csproj || resourceExtname == .fsproj || resourceExtname == .vbproj || resourceExtname == .vcxproj

sharpdeps.maxProjects.markdownDescription: Maximum number of projects or namespaces displayed. Does not limit analysis.

sharpdeps.maxEdges.markdownDescription: Maximum number of displayed relations. Does not limit analysis or cycle detection.

sharpdeps.analysisMode.markdownDescription: Analysis mode. Quick works without the .NET SDK; Semantic uses MSBuild and Roslyn and is only used when selected explicitly.

sharpdeps.resultProvider.markdownDescription: Result provider for Show/Refresh Dependency Map. Legacy keeps Quick/Semantic analysis. SavedIndex reads an existing .sharpdeps index with the shared Query engine; it never analyzes or updates it. An absent index can display a retained legacy report from the same workspace, read-only.

sharpdeps.savedIndexVariant.markdownDescription: Exact saved hvar_ ID for the savedIndex provider. Required when the saved index contains multiple variants. Blank selects a variant only when exactly one exists; variants are never combined implicitly.

sharpdeps.analysisTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Time limit for one analysis run, in seconds. When exceeded, the run is stopped and the process tree it started is terminated.

sharpdeps.dotnetPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `dotnet` executable to use. When empty, SharpDeps resolves one via the .NET Install Tool (`dotnet.findPath`), then `PATH`, then acquires a private .NET runtime on demand.

sharpdeps.maxVisibleTypes.markdownDescription: Maximum number of types in the graph. Search and analysis still cover the full result.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:analyzer && npm run build -- --production
